alumni_progress.name: alumni_progress

CREATE TABLE `alumni_progress` (

  `siswa_id` bigint(20) unsigned NOT NULL,
  `study_tracer_id` bigint(20) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `tahun_lulus` varchar(255) NOT NULL,

  `periode` varchar(50) DEFAULT NULL,
  `semester` tinyint(3) unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `penerima_kipk` tinyint(1) DEFAULT NULL,
  `nominal_ukt` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `nominal_ipi` decimal(15,2) DEFAULT NULL,

  CONSTRAINT `alumni_progress_siswa_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`siswa_id`) REFERENCES `siswa` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `alumni_progress_study_tracer_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`study_tracer_id`) REFERENCES `study_tracer` (`id`) ON DELETE SET NULL
